title: CUTLASS SM100 f16 GEMM, TMA output store

computation.summary: The kernel multiplies A by B and scales the product by the configured alpha to form D. Configured beta is 0.0, and C is a declared source descriptor for the beta term.
computation.caption: M names output rows, N output columns, K the shared reduction axis; these are logical dimensions. C, same M by N extent as D, feeds the beta term. Descriptor axes are not drawn as rows.

finding.summary: D is written back to global memory by TMA tensor stores. The run is race_free with retained duplicate-tma-store warnings: unordered stores to D match in footprint and site-visit index, and value equality is not proven.

code.caption: Representative first of four D store sites; retained events are not uniquely assigned to it.
code.roles: %p176 skips the store when (tid.x & 96) is non-zero. The tensor store copies a shared-memory tile at %r718 to D through descriptor %rd139. Commit groups the issuing thread's store.
code.scope: Local guard only: x 0-31 and 128-159 may issue if this block is reached. Outer exits are not applied, and actual issuers are not established.

final_wait.reason: Configured beta is 0.0, so the beta == 0 test at 4016 branches past the drain; the other entrance, 3987, is not taken.

next: Inspect whether the stored values from the matching same-warp store pairs are equal, since the saved rule matches footprints and site visits without proving equal data.

source_sections.title: Output store operation and local guard
source_sections.answer: Four unrolled sites store shared-memory tiles to D with a 3D tensor store, commit, and a read-1 wait. The evaluated local guard admits x 0-31 and 128-159; actual issuers and full-path eligibility are not established.

steps.label: Thread mask source
steps.text: %r2 is mov.u32 %tid.x (72). %r83 = %r2 & 96 (2837). %p176 = (%r83 != 0) (3242); the branch at 3335 skips the store when %p176 is true, so the guard passes where (tid.x & 96) == 0.

steps.label: Repeated sites
steps.text: The stores at 3339, 3541, 3733 and 3937 each use %p176, %p182, %p186 or %p190 (all set from %r83 != 0 at 3242, 3445, 3639, 3829) and differ in the tile coordinate. The fourth site waits under %p191, also %r83 != 0 (3943).

steps.label: Scope
steps.text: Outer exits are not applied; the 64 x values are a local predicate result, not a count of issuing threads, and x values are not full thread identities.

code.caption: Fourth site, whose wait has its own guard.

source_sections.title: Beta scalar and final read-0 drain
source_sections.answer: Under the configured inputs the final read-0 wait at 4019 is skipped. Beta is 0.0 from its first load, the later reloads are bypassed, and the beta == 0 test branches past the drain. This is static configuration analysis, not a runtime trace.

steps.label: Live value
steps.text: beta (offset 1280, configured 0.0) is loaded into %rs1 at 126. Reloads at 2572 and 3035 are bypassed by branches at 2560 (%p210, beta.stride = 0) and 3023 (%p161, beta.stride = 0), so %rs1 stays 0.0.

steps.label: Incoming paths
steps.text: The drain label $L__BB0_277 (4017) is entered by the direct jump at 3987 and by fall-through from 4016. Both are checked separately; they are not joined with OR.

steps.label: Final gate
steps.text: Entering 3987: %p166 = not(%p165 or %p1) with %p165 = (beta.stride == 0) true, so %p166 is false and the jump is not taken. 3989 tests beta.stride != 0, false. 4000 jumps to 4015. %p1 (3999) = (%rs1 == 0.0 in f16), true, so 4016 branches to $L__BB0_278, past the wait.

code.caption: Final drain and its two entrances.
